scope: Compact Weber find-verify-fix audit method packet adapted from the SGA5 live source-audit workflow. This belongs on the workflow/replication record, not as a promoted Weber reader.
observed_contents: WEBER_AUDIT_METHOD_AND_PLAN.md explaining the SGA5 find-verify-fix method and its Weber-specific adaptation, including the 2026-06-25 priority correction: German transcription/source completeness first; English translation later.
weber_audit_workflow.js runnable workflow prompt/script for Weber German transcription-vs-scan auditing.
chunk_page.py, measure_sources.py, and build_manifest.py helper scripts.
audit_manifest.json, the compact three-volume page/offset/control manifest.
workflow_lessons: The SGA5 page-local find -> verify -> fix pattern transfers to Weber German transcription, but Weber's immediate priority is omission/summarization detection in the German branch, not English translation.
The current Weber German TeX is a half-baked GPT draft and must be audited for missing lines, compressed prose, and missing formulae before fine symbol forensics.

Local source measurement found no native >=650dpi Weber scan on disk: Band I and III are about 500dpi and Band II about 560dpi, so tight crops and explicit uncertainty flags are required for hard symbols.
The workflow separates type A source deviations from type B source typos and cosmetic differences.
Every accepted fix still requires foreground/human review before application; the agent output is patch-ready evidence, not authority.
One workflow at a time is safer than many concurrent workflows because the limiting factor observed in SGA5/Weber lanes is server/tool reliability and rate limiting rather than local CPU/GPU.
The packet deliberately excludes bulky rendered source chunks; those should be generated on demand from the manifest.
caveats: This package does not certify Weber and should not be attached to the Weber author record as a reader replacement.
The included audit manifest is a control/harness layer; it is not a proof that all pages have been audited.
next_action: Attach to the workflow/replication record during the next deliberate workflow DOI refresh, alongside the SGA5 find-verify-fix method snapshot.
